apod_title: JWST Images The Lion's Head Nebula
label: namecode - NEBULA | 13.448
prompt: Cinematic dark monochrome generative art inspired by JWST Images The Lion's Head Nebula. Are we looking at the future of our Sun? The James Webb Space Telescope captured today’s composite image of the Lion’s Head Nebula (NGC 2392) with its NIRCam and MIRI instruments. The Lion’s Head Rendered as fine white particles and light filaments on a pure black background, volumetric, dramatic, monochrome white on black, lots of negative space, high detail.
